title: Using AI to help solo-develop a complex cellular automata ecosystem sim (Everwood - Now in Alpha!)
author: Mazhron
selftext:
Hey everyone,

I wanted to share a project I've been working on called **Everwood**. It's an incremental idle-clicker rogue-lite wrapped in a living ecological simulation.

Building a game where every single cell has 14 tiers of soil vitality, dynamic water physics, weather systems, and an animal food chain is a massive undertaking for a solo developer.

**How AI helped me build this:**  
I used Claude to do all of the programming, I actually created my own "OS" (Claude called it that, not me, you can view it here: [https://github.com/Mazhron/rootstock-os](https://github.com/Mazhron/rootstock-os)). This has been a HUGE help reducing token costs, keeping Claude and Sub agents on task with the exact knowledge needed to build the game, which grows as the game grows. It can be adapted to nearly any project, I've given it to multiple people for a multitude of projects and it works well for other projects as well. Point your Claude there and see how it can help your next project!

I used Claude to generate the initial graphics very few of those are left in the game), and I've used Gemini to generate the rest. I have edited a great many of them by hand using Gimp.

I used Claude to help balance the massive spreadsheets required for the incremental math and prestige scaling. I created my own upgrade and plant webs that I can use to visually see everything, edit and give back to Claude to implement.

The game is finally in a playable Alpha state, featuring 5 different biomes (from Grasslands to a radioactive Wasteland) and a full prestige loop where you sacrifice your grown forests for permanent upgrades. Part of this loop is "Memories" for upgrading. Basically, the lore is you are nature itself, and after creating a perfect world, you went to sleep. You forgot most of your powers, but after people destroyed your world (war), you've awoken to rebuild it. So the "Memories" you gain are of your powers, abilities, tools, etc.

I’d love for you guys to check out what I was able to put together and give me some feedback on the gameplay loop!

**Play Everwood in your browser:** [https://mazhron.itch.io/everwood](https://mazhron.itch.io/everwood)
